correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the two supports, including the horizontal limit and chord; folding uniform unoriented angles gives exactly 2/pi. The derivative factors as (t+2a)(t²−2at+2)/[4(1+t²)^(3/2)], with stationary slopes a±sqrt(a²−2) for a>sqrt(2), both in the first branch. Only the vertical endpoint and the larger stationary slope can minimize. At a stationary root with x=t², a=(x+2)/(2 sqrt(x)); comparison with a² reduces to the sign of −x³+8x²+24x+16, unique positive root above x=2. Reducing that cubic modulo x²−4(a²−1)x+4 and multiplying the two residues reproduces the claimed polynomial in a². At a=sqrt(2), integrating the quadratic zero of the derivative and converting dt/dtheta=3 gives angular coefficient 3 sqrt(6)/4; a unique local inverse fixes both density and band mass. Scaling t−sqrt(2) by sqrt(delta) and integrating the limiting parabola gives 4·2^(3/4)/(3 sqrt(3)). The repaired RESULT.md gives a replayable analytic derivation. The frozen VERIFICATION.md, code and CHECKS.txt are supplementary recorded diagnostics; the uploaded code was inspected, not executed.
